name: M3_PDS030MI_SelPatternLines
description: Retrieve all shift pattern lines for a range of facilities to support capacity planning based on predefined shift patterns and shift models. The operation covers every pattern line belonging to the selected facilities, together with validity dates, the number of days covered by each line, and the referenced shift model. Descriptive text and short names for the shift pattern or shift model are included so external planning or scheduling tools can present user-friendly information. Audit fields indicate when each line was last changed and by whom, enabling traceability of planning data changes.

inputParameters.name: FFAC
inputParameters.description: Starting facility in the facility range used to select shift pattern lines.

inputParameters.name: TFAC
inputParameters.description: Ending facility in the facility range used to select shift pattern lines.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number to use when selecting shift pattern lines.

inputParameters.name: WHGR
inputParameters.description: Warehouse group whose production calendar is used as a basis when selecting shift pattern lines.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the returned shift pattern line.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility for which this shift pattern line is defined.

outputParameters.name: SHPA
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the shift pattern to which this line belongs.

outputParameters.name: FDAT
outputParameters.description: Start date from which this shift pattern line is valid.

outputParameters.name: TDAT
outputParameters.description: End date through which this shift pattern line is valid.

outputParameters.name: SHFM
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the shift model used on this shift pattern line.

outputParameters.name: NODY
outputParameters.description: Number of consecutive days that this shift pattern line applies the referenced shift model.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Description of the shift model referenced by this shift pattern line.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this shift pattern line was last modified.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Revision number that is incremented each time this shift pattern line is changed.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person who last changed or created this shift pattern line.

outputParameters.name: TX15
outputParameters.description: Short name of the shift model referenced by this shift pattern line.
